entries.text: Welcome to the Medali Gym! Would you like me\nto explain the Gym Test rules to you again?
entries.label: gym_normal_020_receptionist_01

entries.text: The Gym Test here is to [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]order a special secret[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]menu item[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!
entries.label: gym_normal_020_receptionist_02

entries.text: The menu in question belongs to the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Treasure[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Eatery[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], a much-loved restaurant here in Medali.\c\nOrder correctly, and you pass!
entries.label: gym_normal_020_receptionist_03

entries.text: Right now, there are three other challengers\naround town attempting this Gym Test.
entries.label: gym_normal_020_receptionist_04

entries.text: Each of them has been given a different clue to\nhelp them discover the secret dish. You’ve been\r\ngiven one as well.
entries.label: gym_normal_020_receptionist_05

entries.text: Please find and battle the other challengers.\nThe loser must tell the winner their clue!
entries.label: gym_normal_020_receptionist_06

entries.text: Your goal is to obtain all four clues, use them\nto determine the secret dish, then order it from\r\nthe waiter at the Treasure Eatery.
entries.label: gym_normal_020_receptionist_07

entries.text: Only the challenger who’s able to order correctly\nwill pass the test!
entries.label: gym_normal_020_receptionist_08

entries.text: Your clue is to find out [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]how the regulars season[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]their dishes[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].
entries.label: gym_normal_020_receptionist_09

entries.text: I’d suggest you start by hearing what a regular\nat the Treasure Eatery has to say!
entries.label: gym_normal_020_receptionist_10

entries.text: Hm? Oh, yes, I suppose I do come here often.[VAR 0x0114(0038)]
entries.label: gym_normal_020_normal_02a

entries.text: You must be a Gym Test challenger...[VAR 0x0114(0038)]
entries.label: gym_normal_020_normal_03a

entries.text: Well, what I’m having right now is something\nquite ordinary, but...[VAR 0x0114(0038)]
entries.label: gym_normal_020_normal_02b

entries.text: Here’s a tip for you. A nice squeeze of [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]lemon[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\ngives any dish a refreshing kick.[VAR 0x0114(0038)]
entries.label: gym_normal_020_normal_04

entries.text:
Here’s a tip for you. A nice squeeze of [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]lemon[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]
gives any dish a refreshing kick.\c
Though...I daresay someone as young as you
might not really appreciate that taste just yet.[VAR 0x0114(0038)]
entries.label: gym_normal_020_normal_05

entries.text: What’s this...? There’s some faint writing here.\nIt says “Fire Blast.”
entries.label: gym_normal_020_fall_01

entries.text: Ah, one of the Gym Test challengers!\c\nI hope you’re able to figure out our special\nsecret menu item.
entries.label: gym_normal_030_shop_00

entries.text: Now, tell me... What will you be ordering?
entries.label: gym_normal_030_shop_01

entries.text: And what size serving will you be having?
entries.label: gym_normal_030_shop_02

entries.text: How do you want that cooked?
entries.label: gym_normal_030_shop_03

entries.text: This looks like a regular dish...
entries.label: gym_normal_030_system_01

entries.text: Thank you very much! Hope you enjoyed\nyour meal!
entries.label: gym_normal_030_shop_06

entries.text: Maybe that wasn’t the right thing to order...\nYou should try ordering something else!
entries.label: gym_normal_030_system_02

entries.text: Medium-serving grilled rice balls, Fire Blast style,\nwith fresh lemon on the side!
entries.label: gym_normal_030_shop_07

entries.text: Gotcha! Medium rice balls, extra crispy,\nwith lemon!
entries.label: gym_normal_030_cook_01

entries.text: Congratulations! You’ve passed the Gym Test!
entries.label: gym_normal_030_shop_08

entries.text: You now have the right to challenge the\nGym Leader!
entries.label: gym_normal_030_shop_09

entries.text: Please come speak to me again when you’re\nready to battle.
entries.label: gym_normal_030_shop_10
